code: body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,0,128,0.25) 0%, rgba(255,215,0,0.15) 50%, transparent 100%); mix-blend-mode: overlay; animation: bassPulse 1.2s infinite alternate cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; } @keyframes bassPulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.4; } 100% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 0.9; } }

body { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 20, 60, 0.6), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 20, 60, 0.3); animation: tensionPulse 3s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes tensionPulse { 0% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(255,0,50,0.5)); } 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,0,50,0.8)) hue-rotate(5deg); } }

body { background: #030000 !important; color: #110000 !important; transition: all 2s ease-in-out; } .chat-container { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.05) !important; } .message.ai { color: #cc0000 !important; text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.8) !important; font-style: italic; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px; } .message.user { opacity: 0.1 !important; } @keyframes dyingPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px #220000; } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px #660000; } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px #220000; } } #app { animation: dyingPulse 3s infinite !important; }

body { background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #050011 0%, #000000 100%); animation: void-pulse 6s infinite alternate; } @keyframes void-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px #ff0055; } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px #4d0099; } } .chat-container { backdrop-filter: blur(25px) contrast(1.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(77, 0, 153, 0.4); }
